name: KiTS 23
short_description: KiTS23 is a public multi-institutional benchmark dataset released for the 2023 Kidney and Kidney Tumor Segmentation Challenge. It contains contrast-enhanced abdominal CT scans of patients with renal masses, with voxel-level semantic segmentation labels for kidneys, renal tumours and renal cysts. The dataset is designed for development and benchmarking of automatic 3D segmentation algorithms, and is commonly used for kidney/tumour/cyst segmentation, radiomics preprocessing, model validation and algorithm comparison in renal tumour imaging.
phase: Contrast-enhanced CT; includes late arterial/corticomedullary, portal venous and nephrogenic phase cases.

related_papers.title: 2023 Kidney and Kidney Tumor Segmentation Challenge
